boulderdash: Must read (and ideally write) **BDCFF**. The classic cave sets in BDCFF come with GDash (MIT), which is also the reference for exact engine rules (cave timing, amoeba, magic wall, slime, explosions). Also check Rocks'n'Diamonds (GPL-2.0) level-set formats and the extended engines it supports.
fruityfrank: No community format found. Define a simple text-grid format in the same style as BDCFF. A CPC disk importer is optional and comes later.
alleycat: No maps: fixed alley and window rooms. rhuizer/alleycat (GPL-3.0) is a reimplementation of the IBM PC version to use as a behaviour reference.
wintergames: None: the events are fixed content.
cannonfodder: Read the original CF1/CF2 map (`.map`) and sprite-placement (`.spt`) files as Open Fodder (GPL-3.0) does, plus OpenFodder Editor output. Open Fodder also runs the free Amiga cover-disk demo data, which is legal test material.
doubledragon: None worth targeting: OpenBOR fan mods contain the original IP.
z: Read Zod Engine maps (GPL-3.0; the fenio fork has 34 campaign maps and a procedural skirmish generator). Original Z data importer: format still to investigate.
rampart: None to import: the arcade maps are fixed. Our coastlines and castle layouts will be data files (our own format, CC BY-SA), so new maps can be shared as packs.
